title: Goodwill Release Taken off a Hotel Rate Plans Cancellation Charge for Club Members
content:
Where an active membership of the Wanderlane Traveller Club stands in the guest's name, a goodwill release is taken off the amount withheld on a Hotel Rate Plans cancellation. The size of that release turns on the club points the membership has accrued from hotel nights.

## The rule

1. Where an active traveller club membership stands in the guest's name and at least 15000 club points have accrued from hotel nights in the twelve months ending on the handling date, the goodwill release taken off the amount withheld is the hotel rate discount carried by the tier that membership stands at.
2. Where an active traveller club membership stands in the guest's name and fewer than 15000 club points have accrued from hotel nights in those twelve months, the goodwill release is half that hotel rate discount — that is, 50 percent of it.
3. Where no active traveller club membership stands in the guest's name, no goodwill release is taken off.

## Where the figures are read from

The membership and the tier it stands at are read from the Wanderlane Traveller Club membership record standing in the guest's name, and the hotel rate discount is the one that tier carries. The points counted are the points entries accrued to that membership from hotel nights, over the twelve months ending on the handling date; points accrued from anything else, and points accrued outside those twelve months, are not counted.

## The threshold at its edges

| Membership standing in the guest's name | Club points accrued from hotel nights in the twelve months to the handling date | Goodwill release |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active | 15001 | the hotel rate discount of the tier held |
| active | 15000 | the hotel rate discount of the tier held |
| active | 14999 | half that discount |
| active | 0 | half that discount |
| none, or not active | any | none |

A membership standing exactly at 15000 points reaches the threshold; one standing at 14999 does not.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

An amount withheld of 500.00 USD before any release, with a hypothetical hotel rate discount of 6 percent carried by the tier the membership stands at:

- With 20000 club points accrued from hotel nights in the twelve months to the handling date, the release is 6 percent and the figure becomes 470.00 USD.
- With 9000 such points, the release is half of 6 percent, being 3 percent, and the figure becomes 485.00 USD.
- With no active membership in the guest's name, no release is taken and the figure stands at 500.00 USD.
